summary.text: Philip Oehlerking is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 100 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, in a race that also includes Mary Ann Perkins and Ken Newhouse.
He works as a business analyst.

paragraphs.text: Oehlerking earned an associate degree from St. Louis Community College in 2013 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri-St. Louis in 2015, and his career experience includes working as a business analyst.
Oehlerking assumed office in the Missouri House of Representatives on January 4, 2023, succeeding Derek Grier.
His 2025-2026 committee assignment is Financial Institutions, where he is vice chair.
